claims.summary: Cambridge Japanese–English Dictionary identifies **コンビニ** as an abbreviation of **コンビニエンスストア** and defines it as a small shop selling foods and similar goods with long opening hours. The entry does not make 24-hour operation or any particular services part of the word’s definition; those depend on each shop.
